label: prf:genus-ideal-characterisation
title: Proof of the genus-filtration ideal characterisation
html:
Proof. At genus g = 4 (taken as given; the cited genus from Hecke completeness proves a count, not the spanning condition that would fix g -- see the block-rank remark), the Seifert embedding \iota \colon F_p \hookrightarrow \Sigma_4 induces \iota_* \colon H_1(F_p) \to H_1(\Sigma_4). The Seifert surface F_p has \mathrm{rank} H_1(F_p) = (p-1)/2. For \iota_* to be injective (necessary for a Seifert embedding), (p-1)/2 \leq 4.

In Hecke coordinates: each degree u^k in a_p (Chebyshev degree = Seifert genus) corresponds to the k-th Seifert cycle \gamma_k \in H_1(F_p). The truncation \pi_4 \colon \mathbb{Z}[u] \to \mathbb{Z}[u]/(u^5) projects onto the cycles that fit in H_1(\Sigma_4). The kernel \mathfrak{I}_4 = (u^5) consists of the terms with no target. \square
